chunks: And from him from Mu'awiya ibn Wahb from 'Umar ibn Yazid who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'A Hajj is superior to freeing seventy slaves.'
ai.seo_question: What is the reward of Hajj compared to freeing slaves?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elevates the spiritual status of Hajj by comparing it to the significant act of manumission, noting that freeing seventy slaves was a major form of expiation (kaffarah) in Islamic jurisprudence. This comparison underscores the unique, all-encompassing merit of the pilgrimage, which serves as a comprehensive means of spiritual purification and divine forgiveness in Shia tradition.
